brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Organizer to keep sewing supplies tidy with small compartments
requirements.evidence: 3-cell build (piece:0,0,0 + 0,-1,0 + 1,0,0) with divided bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) plus bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 each 2 compartments = 7 compartments total for sorting. Bins are open-top and compartmented; build capped and joint-locked, meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built a 3-hex tidy with 7 divided compartments (1x 3-compartment + 2x 2-compartment bins) for sorting notions, with capped faces and locked joints. Dressed with workshop notions to show purpose; dedicated sewing props are not available in the catalog.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
